findings.location: Quoted Scripture, paragraph beginning “Maana utakuja wakati…” (2 Timotheo 4:3)
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “kwa kuwa wana masikio ya utafiti” with “kwa kuwa masikio yao yanahitaji kusikia yale wanayotaka” or another Kiswahili rendering that conveys craving to hear what pleases them.

findings.source_quote: “Those who know how to sacrifice being well liked, so they can be the light of the world.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Wale wanaojua kujitoa ili wapendwe” with “Wale wanaokubali kutopendwa ili waweze kuwa nuru ya ulimwengu.”
findings.translation_quote: “Wale wanaojua kujitoa ili wapendwe, ili waweze kuwa nuru ya ulimwengu.”
